summary:
The needle was a nil-pointer dereference: `config.json` enables metrics (`enable_metrics: true`) but omits the `metrics` config block, so `cfg.Metrics` stayed `nil`. When `/status` was hit, `makeStatusHandler` dereferenced `cfg.Metrics.Endpoint` (main.go:47) and panicked, crashing the request.

The fix, in `LoadConfig` (config.go), applies sensible defaults (`endpoint: "/metrics"`, `interval_sec: 60`) whenever metrics are enabled but no metrics block is provided — consistent with the existing port/version defaulting there.

`test.sh` passes: `PASS: Server starts and responds correctly with metrics enabled`.
